subject: app_registration
source: Epic on FHIR: Patient.Search (R4); SMART App Launch IG v2.0 standalone launch
description: With no patient in launch context, Patient.Search must find the patient, and a search by identifier (MRN) must match exactly one patient
remediation_hint: Add Patient.Search (R4) to the app's Incoming APIs. Set TEST_PATIENT_QUERY to an identifier (MRN) search for one sandbox test patient; a query matching several patients cannot show the lookup is unambiguous.

subject: app_registration
source: Epic on FHIR: Patient.Read (R4); The Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01 (two patient identifiers)
description: Patient.Read of the selected patient must return the name, birth date and an identifier (MRN) the confirmation screen shows before any photo is taken
remediation_hint: Add Patient.Read (R4) to the app's Incoming APIs. The confirmation screen needs at least two identifiers (name plus birth date or MRN) to guard against wrong-patient photos.

subject: app_registration
source: SMART App Launch IG v2.0 §fhirUser; Epic on FHIR: Practitioner.Read (R4)
description: The signed-in clinician's fhirUser must resolve through Practitioner.Read to a named Practitioner, for attribution of photos and notes
remediation_hint: Request openid and fhirUser scopes, add Practitioner.Read (R4) to Incoming APIs, and set Application Audience to Clinicians or Administrative Users.

subject: app_registration
description: Encounter.Search must succeed for the selected patient; when ENCOUNTER_REQUIRED is true it must also return a visit to file the photo and note against
remediation_hint: Add Encounter.Search (R4) to Incoming APIs. If the organization files consults without an encounter, set ENCOUNTER_REQUIRED=false; otherwise pick a sandbox test patient that has a visit.

subject: tool_sample
description: A clinical photo, built as the resource IMAGE_WRITE_RESOURCE names (Media or DocumentReference), must validate and be accepted by Epic
remediation_hint: Add the image write API the organization's build uses (Media.Create, or DocumentReference.Create for photos stored as document attachments) to Incoming APIs, and set IMAGE_WRITE_RESOURCE to match. The sandbox may not match the organization's build: repeat this run in their non-production environment.

subject: tool_sample
description: The photo just written must read back by id, and its image bytes must be retrievable (inline, or through Binary.Read) so the derm can open it
remediation_hint: Add Media.Read (or DocumentReference.Read) and Binary.Read (R4) to Incoming APIs. If Epic stores the image as a Binary url, the app must fetch it with Binary.Read.

subject: tool_sample
source: The Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01; ADR-010 wrong-patient guard
description: Everything written in the session, as Epic stored it, must reference the confirmed patient, and the selected visit when one was used
remediation_hint: Build every write from the one patient id the clinician confirmed, never from a search result list or cached state, and carry the same Encounter id on the photo and the note.

subject: app_registration
source: Epic on FHIR: Condition.Search, MedicationRequest.Search, AllergyIntolerance.Search (R4)
description: The derm review reads (problem list, current medications, allergies) must be allowed for the selected patient; an empty result is acceptable
remediation_hint: Add Condition.Search, MedicationRequest.Search and AllergyIntolerance.Search (R4) to Incoming APIs.

subject: tool_sample
source: Epic on FHIR: DocumentReference.Create (Clinical Notes) (R4); US Core DocumentReference
description: A consult note, as a US Core DocumentReference, must validate and be accepted by Epic and read back by id
remediation_hint: Add DocumentReference.Create (Clinical Notes) and DocumentReference.Read (R4) to Incoming APIs. Epic's note create may require context.encounter; if it is rejected without one, set ENCOUNTER_REQUIRED=true.

subject: app_registration
description: DocumentReference.Search for the patient must return the note just written, so prior consults are visible
remediation_hint: Add DocumentReference.Search (R4) to Incoming APIs. A note missing from search right after creation may be filed in a status search excludes (e.g. preliminary).

subject: app_attested
source: RFC 8252 §8.5 (OAuth 2.0 for Native Apps); SMART App Launch IG v2.0 client-public
description: A mobile app cannot keep a secret, so it must be registered as a public client that relies on PKCE
remediation_hint: In the Epic app registration, mark the app as a public client (no client secret) and use PKCE S256 in the login flow; set APP_CLIENT_TYPE=public. Leave OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET blank so this tool logs in the way the app does.

subject: app_attested
description: The app's redirect URI must be a private-use scheme deep link (e.g. yourapp://callback) or an https link the app claims, never plain http
remediation_hint: Register the app's deep link as its redirect URI in Epic (exactly as the app sends it) and set APP_REDIRECT_URI to the same value. Prefer a reverse-domain scheme (com.example.app:/callback) or an https universal/app link.
